cells.note: Shareholder communications and proxy service · United States / global
cells.detail: Broadridge can carry proxy voting, issuer communications and regulatory disclosures into tokenized-security arrangements.

cells.note: Role in the SEC order: supporting layer

cells.text: Broadridge launched DLX on September 9 as a multi-chain orchestration layer connecting tokenization, trading, settlement, books and records, custody, wallets and established market systems.
cells.detail: Where the proof stops: Platform launch and stated DTCC/Canton connectivity do not prove every module, client workflow or asset class is in production.

items: Stock + rights record · Corporate actions + proxy: ProxyVote and communications fill a rights-servicing sublayer that a token contract alone does not provide.
Interoperability + services · API / integration, Failure authority: The service must reconcile token-holder data to the incumbent shareholder communications chain.

cells.text: Governance servicing is not the transfer agent's authoritative ownership record, the custodian's position, venue operation or settlement finality.
cells.note: Watch: Issuer mandates, account and token-holder reconciliation, vote entitlement proofs, distribution completion and correction records.
